profile.summary: Oakland Unity Middle School is a free public charter middle school in East Oakland, California, serving students in grades 6 to 8. It is authorized by the Alameda County Office of Education and opened in 2015. The school is run by Unity Schools, a nonprofit that also operates Oakland Unity High School.
